verdict.rationale: Crossplane's declarative model only implies bulk operations: a function pipeline and Composite Resource Definitions let one higher-level API orchestrate many underlying resources, and the control plane reconciles them continuously. Nothing in the evidence explicitly documents acting on many items at once. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk or multi-resource operations (e.g., batch apply, delete or update across many managed resources), CLI bulk commands, AI-agent-driven bulk workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
